I saved this in a private memory note at `/workspace/memory/members/ilse-varga.md`. The note is labelled as coming from her DM and is only to be used when answering Ilse herself, never with other members or in channels.

I didn't put it in the shared files. The world tools have no way to write files, and Ilse's existing notes folder there is public anyway.
